adk.label: Google ADK
adk.description: Daily standup agent built with Google ADK. Pulls Jira, Slack, and Calendar via the CData Query MCP.

typescript.label: TypeScript (Gemini)
next: cp .env.example .env  # fill in CDATA_PAT, CDATA_ACCT_EMAIL, and GEMINI_API_KEY
npm start              # opens the ADK web UI

python.label: Python (Anthropic or OpenAI via LiteLLM)
next: pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # fill in CDATA_PAT, CDATA_ACCT_EMAIL, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY
adk web                # opens the ADK web UI (agent: daily_standup)

next: cp .env.example .env  # fill in CDATA_PAT, CDATA_ACCT_EMAIL, and one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY
